description: On desktop, the app's own page may run a user-only action stepper's steps through the action_* commands (HAL-17525, HAL-18084): send a reviewed call step from the compiled route list with the user's own token, which stays in the OS keychain; sign in to GitHub with its device flow while the stepper is open, cancel it, sign out and name the signed-in account; and open a reviewed guided page or a checked browser block's address. It is local only, so the Studio the computer serves gets none of it.
